name: DBpedia_SPARQL_query
description: Execute SELECT or ASK queries against the public DBpedia SPARQL endpoint. SELECT results are recoverably paginated with a one-extra-row probe: continue with next_offset while has_more is true. Explicit max_results/offset override terminal LIMIT/OFFSET clauses, while an omitted max_results uses the query LIMIT or defaults to 100. Both normalized values and original binding metadata (URI/literal type, datatype, language) are returned. ASK returns its boolean rather than a misleading empty list. CONSTRUCT and DESCRIBE are explicitly unsupported.

sparql.description: SPARQL query string to execute against DBpedia. Use SPARQL syntax to query entities, relationships, and properties. DBpedia uses different property names than Wikidata (e.g., dbo:abstract, dbo:birthDate, rdfs:label).

max_results.description: Optional SELECT page size override (1-1000). If omitted, use the terminal query LIMIT or default to 100.

offset.description: Optional zero-based SELECT result offset. Continue with data.next_offset while data.has_more is true.

test_examples.sparql: SELECT ?person ?name ?birthDate WHERE { ?person rdf:type dbo:Person . ?person rdfs:label ?name . ?person dbo:birthDate ?birthDate . FILTER(LANG(?name) = 'en') } LIMIT 5
SELECT ?book ?title ?author WHERE { ?book rdf:type dbo:Book . ?book rdfs:label ?title . ?book dbo:author ?author . FILTER(LANG(?title) = 'en') } LIMIT 3
SELECT ?place ?name ?country WHERE { ?place rdf:type dbo:Place . ?place rdfs:label ?name . ?place dbo:country ?country . FILTER(LANG(?name) = 'en') } LIMIT 3
